resources.string: Record private, structured app diagnostics for troubleshooting.

Enable logging on this device? Records timestamps, app/Android versions, request categories, HTTP statuses, attestation stages and player error codes. No URLs, tokens, passwords, certificates, book text, photos or request bodies. This setting persists until turned off and does not change server security.
Off by default. Up to 512 KiB stays on this device, excluded from backup. Turning off stops recording; Clear logs removes existing records. This is not a full Android logcat dump.
Choose where to save the text file. It includes activity timestamps and technical diagnostics. Review it before sharing. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
Could not update or save diagnostic logs
Some events could not be recorded. Check free space or clear the log.
